native_mechanisms: Eight violin strings bound under one bridge on the counting-bars: each pluck shivers into every other string — a coupled multi-lane state that is the mixing engine, with the tremor never allowed to settle between marks (state carried forward across all marks).
A fresh, never-repeated ink-weight feather per mark: a per-position unique weight/key folded into each mark so strict order is fixed into the running count.

The storm's single final pass across the settled tremor, collapsing it into eight small notes (one fixed-size token), after which the pickers destroy every discarded feather and drop (no intermediate state survives).
core_technique: Multiply-free 8-lane absorb loop (xor with a counter-derived per-block key, rotate-xor-add) with explicit cross-lane coupling each block — scalar `v[(j+1)&7] += rotl(v[j],13)`, AVX2 `A+=B; B^=A; permute4x64` — over persistent state, finalized once by a 128-bit multiply fold (mum) chain plus splitmix64.
